# fli-js (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/punitarani/fli (folder `fli-js`), MIT licence (see LICENSE in this folder).
Commit: 881aee5ff4321e81ea2157cb44be94ce6a21dc1b (2026-09-20), copied unmodified.
Not published on npm, so it is vendored. Depends on `zod`.

It reads Google Flights' public search page. This is unofficial and can break whenever Google changes the page,
or be blocked; the app falls back to Bright Data when it fails. To update, re-copy `fli-js/src` from the repo.
